meta.name: Trap 48
meta.description: Rick, the pharmacist, is driven by vengeance after his sister dies from counterfeit drugs sold by Eddie. He is torn between his desire for revenge and a newfound purpose as he returns to school to become a legitimate pharmacist.
meta.slogan: When you have 48 hours to make the perfect decision for your life, and death can't stop you. It don't matter how many chances you get to do whatever you want to do. You only have 48 hours to do it.
